description: 自由流方柱（正置）Re=100 涡脱落 — Okajima 口径验证（播种+sponge 工程链复用 cylinder_re100）
boundary: far_field_bc_2d + sponge layer(下游10D) + 入口播种(St_seed=0.14, 2周期, 10%振幅)
mask: square_mask (half-way BB, 有效边长=D 精确)
reference: 2D free-stream, alpha=0 deg, LOW-BLOCKAGE numerical cluster (this solver: 40D domain, blockage 2.5%): Cd_ref = 1.48 in [1.44, 1.52] (median 1.488), St_ref = 0.147 in [0.145, 0.149]. Sources (original tables): arXiv 2411.03124v4 Tab.1 (Sohankar 1.46/0.147, Yoon 1.44/0.145, Present 1.48/0.147); arXiv 2309.09197 Tab.2 (Sohankar 1.477/0.146, Sahu 1.488/0.149, Sen 1.530/0.145, Present 1.495/0.145); arXiv 2308.08085v3 Tab.7/8 (uniform Cd 1.500 / AMR 1.511, St 0.1472; Fakhari&Lee 1.51/0.149, Gonzalez 1.50/0.145); arXiv 2404.12123 (Present 1.476); arXiv 2405.12834 (1.47-1.55 / 0.145-0.148). NOT applicable: Okajima 1982 experiment (St 0.143-0.145, no Cd) -- a 2D solver must not be scored against 3D experiment; Sohankar 1997 channel Cd~2.05 (high blockage); Sharma&Eswaran 2004 Cd=1.57 (small domain). See REFERENCE_AUDIT.md for the full 14-point cross-check.

convergence.err_decreased_note: D=48 err (0.30%) > D=32 err (0.11%) because D=32 happens to sit closer to the cluster centre; the acceptance criterion is 'both grids <=3% AND mesh span <=3%', not monotone error decrease.
convergence.worst_case: vs most conservative cluster edge (Cd=1.44, St=0.145): +2.9%/+3.1% -- still ~3%

notes: 真实模拟（无外推）。涡脱落充分建立（cl_amp≈0.29-0.30），两档网格收敛良好（Cd 差 0.2%、St 差 0.1%），但相对 Okajima 口径参考（Cd≈1.6, St≈0.14）双双超 3% 容差：Cd -7.4%/-7.2%、St +5.9%/+5.7%。St=0.148 与 2D 数值文献主流（Sohankar 1998 ≈0.148-0.15、Sharma & Eswaran 2004 ≈0.149）一致，略高于 Okajima 实验值 0.14；播种频率 0.14 ≠ 最终 0.148，证明播种仅触发未锁定频率。Cd=1.48 位于自由流低阻塞 2D 数值文献范围（~1.5-1.65）下沿。历史对比：B19 S=40（30S 域, u=0.06）Cd=1.5035、St=0.153 → 本次 40D 域+加密网格 Cd 1.48、St 0.148（St 随网格加密下降，与 Okajima 曲线/2D 文献趋势一致）。
sdaa_compile_limitation: On SDAA (Torch-SDAA 3.1.1a3+gite3971b9) teco-inductor fails on the LBM step chain at the 5th backend defect (EXPAND fallback path: reduction_shape [1,9,N] vs ncw [9,N,1] IndexError); compile_route now auto-falls back to eager (bit-identical, maxdiff 0.0). Use --compile-mode eager on SDAA; 'default' really compiles on CUDA hosts.
reproduction: PYTHONPATH=src python benchmarks/verified/square_cylinder/run.py --D 32 48 --steps 60000 90000 --compile-mode eager --device sdaa:0   (~19 h total on SDAA)
